slides.headline: Daily tadka, daily oil:
slides.emphasis: it all sticks in the duct
slides.body: Grease coats the hood filters and the exhaust duct above every burner.

slides.headline: One spark + greasy duct
slides.body: The duct acts like a chimney. Flames race up it, out of reach.

slides.headline: Clean hood filters
slides.body: Soak and scrub until the metal shines.

slides.headline: Clean the exhaust duct
slides.body: The grease you can't see is the grease that burns.

slides.headline: Check LPG hoses
slides.body: Cracked or loose at the regulator? Replace it.

slides.headline: Oil fire in the kadhai?
slides.body: Keep a K-type extinguisher next to the stove.
